name: Restricted Procedure — Selection Questionnaire (Stage 1)
description: First stage of a restricted procedure. Demonstrates eligibility and capability to be shortlisted for the ITT. Focus is on proving you can do the work, not how you'd do it.
submission_notes: Submitted via buyer's portal. This is a pass/fail + scored shortlisting exercise. Typically 5-8 suppliers are shortlisted from all SQ submissions.
evaluation_method: Part 1-2: Pass/fail (exclusion grounds, eligibility). Part 3: Scored selection criteria — financial standing, technical capability, relevant experience. Top scorers proceed to ITT.

sections.name: Company Information
sections.guidance: Factual company information: legal name, registration number, address, VAT number, year established, number of employees, annual turnover. This is usually a form-fill, not prose.

sections.name: Exclusion Grounds Declaration
sections.guidance: Standard declarations on mandatory and discretionary exclusion grounds under the Procurement Act 2023. Covers: criminal convictions, tax compliance, insolvency, professional misconduct, conflicts of interest. Usually yes/no form responses. Draft standard declarations — Inference Group should be able to answer 'No' to all mandatory exclusion grounds.

sections.name: Economic & Financial Standing
sections.guidance: Demonstrate financial viability. Typically requires: last 2-3 years' turnover, relevant insurance coverage (PI, PL, EL with minimum values), bank reference. For a ~14-person consultancy, be transparent about size while emphasising stability and founder track record.

sections.name: Technical & Professional Capability
sections.guidance: The most important scored section. Provide 2-3 relevant case studies demonstrating capability to deliver this type of work. Each case study should include: client name (if permitted), contract value, dates, scope, your role, outcomes/results, and a referee contact. Select case studies that match the buyer's sector and the contract's technical requirements.

sections.name: Team Capability & Resources
sections.guidance: Demonstrate you have the team to deliver. Summarise key personnel (Richard Davis, Tim Linsell) with relevant qualifications and experience. Show you have capacity — reference total team size and ability to scale. Don't over-commit named individuals.

sections.name: Quality Management & Certifications
sections.guidance: Reference quality management systems, certifications held (Cyber Essentials, ISO 27001 if applicable), and quality processes. Buyers use this to assess organisational maturity. Be honest about what you hold — don't claim certifications you don't have.

sections.name: Policy Compliance
sections.guidance: Confirm policies are in place: equality & diversity, environmental/sustainability, data protection/GDPR, modern slavery, health & safety. Usually yes/no with brief description. Reference the Business AI Alliance for responsible AI governance.

documents_typically_required: Company registration certificate or Companies House extract
Last 2-3 years' audited accounts or management accounts
Case study references (2-3, with referee contact details)
